split_tsv_columns: use StrSplitter to split TSV lines into columns by tab separator
split_string_select_columns: use StrSplitter with indices to keep only specific columns from a split string
split_string_to_dict: use StrSplitter with names and indices to convert split columns into a named dictionary
convert_string_to_int: use StrToIntConverter to parse a string into an integer with a given base
convert_string_to_tensor: use StrToTensorConverter to parse a string into a PyTorch Tensor with optional size and dtype
